name: Yamoto Yumiko
source: A girl that was admitted to the school from outside the country. She is a member of the badminton team. She sees Airi as a rival. She has a very high self-esteem, but also has a very candid side and is easily teased. Her nickname is "Yamato Sauce", whom Airi came up with. When she is called that she becomes really angry.
